data.description: ## Testing Mode GREEN ## Story 0263-62ba — Migrate 4 consumers to PRECONDITIONS, add compaction on epic-closure with ordering contract ## Objective Write a fault-injection test harness that verifies the retry-once contract: when `_read_latest_preconditions` encounters a transient ENOENT (file disappears during compaction atomic rename), it retries once and succeeds on the second attempt. Also assert that a second failure causes a clean exit 1 with a diagnostic message (no silent swallowing). ## Test File to Create `tests/integration/test-preconditions-fault-injection.sh` (new) ## .test-index entries required - `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh: tests/integration/test-preconditions-fault-injection.sh [test_retry_once_succeeds_on_second_attempt]` - `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh: tests/integration/test-preconditions-fault-injection.sh [test_retry_once_fails_with_diagnostic_on_persistent_miss]` ## Test Approach (Given/When/Then) **test_retry_once_succeeds_on_second_attempt:** - Given: a wrapper script that intercepts the first file-read call and removes the PRECONDITIONS file; then re-creates it before the retry interval elapses - When: `_read_latest_preconditions <ticket_dir>` is called via the wrapper - Then: exits 0; returns valid JSON payload from the second attempt; no partial data **test_retry_once_fails_with_diagnostic_on_persistent_miss:** - Given: a temp ticket dir that appears to have a PRECONDITIONS file (directory listing shows it) but the file is always missing when read (simulated via a named pipe or immediate removal) - When: `_read_latest_preconditions <ticket_dir>` is called - Then: exits 1; stderr contains a diagnostic message (not silent failure); does not hang indefinitely ## Implementation Note for Fault Injection The test harness can simulate transient ENOENT by: 1. Creating the ticket dir with valid events 2. Using a bash function override (`_read_latest_preconditions`) to stub the first call to return ENOENT then the real function on second call OR 3. Using a subshell with file manipulation timed to the 50ms sleep window ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] `tests/integration/test-preconditions-fault-injection.sh` exists and is executable   Verify: test -x tests/integration/test-preconditions-fault-injection.sh - [ ] Both test functions present   Verify: grep -c "^test_retry_once" tests/integration/test-preconditions-fault-injection.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 2)}' - [ ] Both tests pass   Verify: bash tests/integration/test-preconditions-fault-injection.sh - [ ] .test-index updated with both entries   Verify: grep -c "test-preconditions-fault-injection.sh" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index | awk '{exit ($1 < 2)}' ## Retry Budget MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model) On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages) On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Fault-injection test: retry-once on transient file-missing during compaction window
